git.note: Release CLI rebuilt from the working tree at 465ed33 (feat(streamed): opt-in authenticated-snapshot range reuse mode). Mode A reproduces the pre-change default authenticated path.

scope: Matched before/after Qwen2.5-7B benchmark of the default mutable-source authenticated reader (Mode A) versus the new opt-in authenticated-snapshot range-reuse reader (Mode B), under identical 8-token greedy workloads, plus a 2-token address-space ladder for bounded-memory verification, output parity, and Rust regressions. The improvement is measured end-to-end, not inferred from read-call counts alone.

environment.filesystem: model on ext4 (/home, /dev/sdc); repo on /mnt/e (NTFS via WSL)
environment.hashing_note: sha2 selects the x86 SHA-NI backend at runtime; re-hash is already hardware-accelerated. The Mode B win is from performing fewer re-hashes of already-authenticated blocks, not from faster hashing.

implementation.mode_a_semantics: Authenticated sources bypass the LRU and re-read + re-hash every covered block on every range call (mutation detected between calls). Unchanged default.
implementation.mode_b_semantics: Authenticated range reads use the bounded LRU. Every block entering the cache is authenticated against the trusted per-block manifest on the miss path (read_authenticated_range fails closed on mismatch). Cache hits reuse already-authenticated retained bytes with no second source read or re-hash (content authenticity, not mutation-event detection). Newly fetched changed bytes fail closed on a miss.

inference_config_common.command: taskset -c 0,1 llmbridge chat <model> --prompt 'The capital of France is' --max-tokens 8 --ctx 128 --threads 2 --backend streamed --metrics --sha256 <sha> --address-space-mb 2048 --workspace-mb 48

mode_a_mutable_8tok.output: Paris. It is located in the northern

mode_b_snapshot_8tok.output: Paris. It is located in the northern

deltas_b_vs_a_8tok.logical_demand_range_bytes_requested: unchanged (50664356129 both) — same work requested; Mode B is not model-size-independent
deltas_b_vs_a_8tok.peak_rss_delta_note: +32.04 MiB == the opt-in 32 MiB reuse cache; still bounded and well under the 256 MiB address-space cap.
deltas_b_vs_a_8tok.interpretation: The bounded cache absorbs the ~2x intra-forward-pass re-reads/re-hashes of already-authenticated 64 KiB blocks (hit rate ~50.5%), halving physical source I/O and SHA-256 hashing while leaving logical demand, output, and integrity unchanged. It does NOT reduce the base model_size x tokens demand; 55.4 GB source I/O for 8 tokens still scales with the model, consistent with the out-of-core design.

address_space_ladder_2tok.note: 2-token runs; all exit 0, output ' Paris.', SHA match, integrity verified. Confirms the bounded 32 MiB reuse cache does not break low-memory execution. Mode A blocks_verified=755540, Mode B blocks_verified=373518 at every limit (consistent ~50% hashing reduction).

regressions.cpp_native_build: compiled as part of the release build (build.rs builds pinned llama.cpp/ggml); build_exit=0
regressions.windows_msvc_native: not exercised this session; validated on WSL2/Linux only

preserved_guarantees.mode_a_default_unchanged: default_policy_authenticated_still_bypasses_cache_and_rereads + the existing mutation-detection tests still pass
preserved_guarantees.sha256_verification_not_removed: Mode B still hashes 774336 blocks for 8 tokens; every block entering the cache is manifest-verified; SHA matches and output is bit-identical
preserved_guarantees.fail_closed: snapshot_policy_rejects_newly_fetched_changed_block_on_miss (a changed uncached block fails closed with InvalidData)

limitations: Mode B is opt-in and is NOT the default; the master spec default remains mutable-source mutation detection.
The win is bounded intra-pass locality; it does not make source I/O model-size-independent (55.4 GB for 8 tokens still scales with model x tokens).

WSL2, not bare metal; the pre-load host-RAM admission heuristic is conservative and can refuse when measured available RAM is transiently low (e.g. page cache after heavy runs); it is unrelated to the enforced RLIMIT_AS, under which Mode B runs at 256 MiB.
Windows MSVC native path not exercised this session.
Resident-backend generated-text parity for 7B remains host-RAM blocked on this 6.7 GiB host; A-vs-B output parity is asserted directly (bit-identical generated text).
classification: COMPLETE (evidence-backed) for: the opt-in production authenticated-snapshot decode mode, its integration into the real streamed decode path, adversarial tests, genuine 7B inference in snapshot mode, matched-workload before/after performance with bit-identical output, bounded-memory verification at 256/512/2048 MiB, and Rust regressions. Mode B is retained as opt-in (default unchanged).
